responsibility: This is the main implementation file for GCC’s compiler-side option semantics beyond raw decoding. It provides routines for interpreting and validating option values, especially debug-format selection and naming, struct-debug option parsing, diagnostic option presentation and documentation links, misspelling-candidate construction, and command-line/producers string generation, operating over the generated cl_options/cl_enums metadata and gcc_options state to turn parsed switches into meaningful compiler configuration and user-facing option information.
same_name_distinction: Provides the non-generated implementation behind the central option subsystem interface in opts.h, such as debug-format interpretation, struct-debug parsing, documentation-link generation, misspelling support helpers, and command-line/producer string construction. Unlike the header, it contains the compiler-side option semantics and executable helper routines rather than the shared option metadata types and declarations.
